name: Rigged Obby
desc:
THIS IS NOT AN OBBY YOU WILL COMPLETE IN 10 MINUTES (probably)
THERE ARE A LOT OF LUCK REQUIRING STAGES IN THIS Experience AND YOU NEED PATIENCE FOR THEM
60 fps recommended, otherwise some stages might feel bad to play (the cube running thing for example) (lower your fps cap to 60 if you're playing on anything higher)

also epilepsy warning on stages 7 14 20 and possibly also 17
